newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-North says debt facility well-bid.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-North says debt facility well-bid.

text.p: Australian minerals, mining equipment and forestry group North Ltd said it had met with solid bidding for its US$550 million syndicated debt facility.
"We have got offers from the banks in excess of our US$550 million (requirement)," North executive director finance Julian Veer told reporters at a press conference.
Only aspects of documentation for the deal remained before financial close, Vear said.
"We expect to close by the end of the month," he added.
The facility mostly would be used as backing for U.S. and domestic commercial paper programmes, the first of which would be launced later this year.
The location of the first facility depended on movements in interest rates over the year, Vear said.
Vear expected nine or 10 banks to make up the loan syndicate but declined to comment on which banks were likely to be involved.
Pricing was seen at 25 basis points over LIBOR.

North has said the facility would consist of US$250 million worth of three-year debt, US$250 million of five-year debt with a US$50 million swingline facility which is a same-day source of U.S. dollar funds, required by credit rating agencies.
The debt will fund North's growth plans which includes the possibility of acquisitions.
"We've got a lot of unutilised financial capacity at the moment and we are therefore looking for projects," Vear said.
